scope: Independent actual-pixel critique of authored raster eight-direction concept sheets. Not editable 3D/native gameplay/animation/economy/device/reference-video approval.
threshold: Strictly above 9.0 with every mandatory scoped check passed; no averaging.

defects.observation: Rear-right 135 repeats the 45 degree projection: the near shaft/end is at image right with the long wall to its left. At 135 the near shaft/end must be at image left with the rear long wall to its right.
defects.repair: Correct rear-right 135 so the near shaft points down-left and the rear long wall extends up-right.

defects.observation: Rear-left 225 repeats the 315 degree projection: near shaft/end at image left. At 225, near shaft/end must be at image right, matching the 45 degree geometric projection for this symmetric module.
defects.repair: Correct rear-left 225 so the near shaft points down-right and the rear long wall extends up-left.

positive_observations: Two coaxial shafts, four top cover bolts and four-corner feet are consistent with ordinary visibility/occlusion.
Top orange cover stays on top; blue ribbed housing reads as a complete gearbox.
Clear component identity distinct from the gear and axle module.

defects.observation: Rear-left 225 repeats the 135/315 projection with the near outer hub on the left. For this symmetric module it should match the opposite 45 degree projection, near hub on the right.
defects.repair: Render 225 with near hub to image right and the axle receding up-left; preserve the opposite rear view of the same bracket/block.

positive_observations: Two hub flanges with six bolts per outward face, one axle, one center orange sleeve, one bracket and one wooden mounting sleeper remain readable.
Far hub offset above the near hub in end views is consistent with elevated camera occlusion, not a defect.
Rounded blue/silver engineering and warm wood match the presentation language.

defects.observation: Rear-left 225 shows the rear drop label on image right, same as 135/315, instead of the image-left foreshortened rear label required at 225.
defects.repair: Move the 225 rear label to the image-left curved side of the band, with appropriate perspective.

defects.observation: The single off-center front-side bung changes physical side across the orbit. Given the front label at 0, 90/135 should put that bung leftward; 225/270/315 should put it rightward. Current 90/135 place it rightward and current 225/270/315 leftward. Front0 near-center, rear180 far-center and front-right45 near-left are broadly correct.
defects.repair: Track the one bung on the same front-facing physical radius throughout: near-center0, near-left45, left90, far-left135, far-center180, far-right225, right270, near-right315.

positive_observations: Single dark cylindrical drum with two raised reinforcing hoops, top/bottom rims, one visible bung per view and continuous orange band.
Crude is unambiguously different from the existing orange rectangular fuel jerrycan.
Front/rear oil-drop labels contain no unrequested lettering, and all objects are fully framed.

retest_required: Preserve R1 attempts and this raw record. Review corrected new-byte candidates in full and detail with exact new SHA256.
